## Constructed finite statement and source mapping

All delivered names use namespace YulangClosure.SemanticFactEndpointInterpretationR68.
The module imports frozen R67. Owner is primitive data, not an interpreted
Inventory: checked TermView observations; exact Term-to-component positions;
component Term/identity vectors; live kind/ordinal coordinates; separate current
value/effect representative vectors with their corresponding live bounds.
Term equality T must retain the entire arena-branded identity. Component.identity
is an opaque complete identity label, never an assertion that equal source-local
ordinals identify Components. Its equality-preserving source encoding, including
both ComponentId::Occurrence and DefinitionValue, is an OPEN source bridge.
The finite view table stands for actual checked store.term_view observations;
its authenticity/completeness is not presumed by an endpoint law.

View retains all original TermView cases and all children: every primitive leaf,
Component, LiveVariable, value extremes, positive/negative Function, Record,
Tuple and Variant. Field.optional and ordered alternative payloads are retained.
Endpoint discrimination uses the outer case and tuple arity, preserving exact
Term handles. Leaf tags map directly as in Rust; Function/Record/Tuple/Variant
and LiveVariable polarity are checked. A Lambda Function is a VALUE endpoint.
Components check exact positions and both round-trips, then live kind/ordinal
and bounds. Value/effect ordinals have distinct Endpoint constructors. Raw rows
remain uncanonicalized; canonical uses only the SAME Owner's current table,
checks both lookup and representative bounds, and leaves nonrow tags unchanged.
No canonical idempotence or arbitrary endpoint completeness is assumed.

This matches InventoryPackage::checked_semantic_endpoint at candidate_receiver.rs
lines 776–889: exact TermView branches, component_terms/components/live_components
checks, session.bounds versus effect_bounds, then canonical_value/canonical_effect
and final representative bounds. PrimitiveFact and decodeFact keep semantic
identity and original lower/upper Terms; lower uses positive polarity and upper
negative. decodeRows processes every source fact in index order, without filtering.
The Rust lower/upper pair need not share a namespace; neither does Lean require it.

branch_equation and leaf/structural/live/component equations expose the exact
branches. component_coordinate_required derives every checked coordinate from
acceptance. Absence, coordinate mismatches, wrong live/structural polarity,
missing representatives and out-of-bounds rows have explicit rejection lemmas.
canonical_value_equation and canonical_effect_equation retain the read and
bounds equations from that SAME Owner. namespaces_distinct covers equal ordinals.
decoded_fact_equations derives identity, both original Terms and all four raw/
canonical equations from actual decoder success. Interpreted is only a name for
those four equations; its concrete use is proved, never supplied as a parameter.
decoded_rows_length/index prove complete positional table preservation;
decoded_table_preserves_all_provenance retains every unchanged edge.
